title: China sentences 3 more Myanmar crime bosses to death in scam centre crackdown | South China Morning Post
text:
Trio among 61 members sentenced from family-run Wei syndicate – one of the notorious ‘four families’ of northern Myanmar

They are among 61 members of the family-run Wei syndicate convicted of running massive cyber scam centres as well as illegal detention and extortion rings out of northern Myanmar targeting victims across China.

Three other key defendants – Wei Qingtao, Kang Min and Xiong Hengxing – were sentenced to life in prison, while 55 accomplices received fixed prison terms ranging from 39 months to 24 years.
